// diagnostic

E1805

Jet won't run this remote target.

What

Jet won't run this remote target.

Why

Remote code runs only as the exact bytes Jet pinned: fetched over https or from the signed registry, checked against `--sha256` when given, and never fetched again under `--locked`.

Fix

Use an `https://` address, check the `--sha256` value, or run once without `--locked` to pin the target.
